description: NSW Traffic Incidents is a dataset listed in Peclet Data Portal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Live Traffic NSW. Incidents, Fires, Floods, Alpine Conditions, Major Events and Roadworks information including GPS coordinates. NSW Traffic Incidents dataset receives data from livetraffic.com. The data are collected from two end-points. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under Transportation, Movements, Parking, Mobility. Its keywords are traffic, transport, roadwork, disaster dashboard, emergency. The portal shows 821 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-peclet-com-au-portal.
